query: SELECT COALESCE(player_character.character_id, npc_agent.character_id) AS "character_id!: i64" FROM action JOIN message ON message.action_id = action.id JOIN history_entry ON history_entry.id = message.id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.branch_id = history_entry.branch_id LEFT JOIN player_character ON player_character.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id LEFT JOIN npc_agent ON npc_agent.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id WHERE action.requesting_tool_execution_id = ?
